profileName: Enterprise Data Subject Request, Retention and Disclosure Binding

cases.input: A request resolves three target tuples across two systems.
cases.expect: Each tuple receives its own determination, execution, evidence and appealability record.
Closure implies neither universal erasure nor activity retirement.

cases.input: The base profile pauses the clock without jurisdiction parameters.
cases.expect: The pause is rejected; default is no pause.

cases.input: Accounting records are suppressed under statutory duty.
cases.expect: They bind to a separate restricted-purpose activity with accepted basis and expiry.

cases.input: The case reaches its retention expiry.
cases.expect: The dataset/record tombstone and proof metadata survive.
It is rejected unless keyed with the key outside the proof.

cases.input: An erased record feeds a derived dataset.
cases.expect: A propagation obligation and derived-target determination are recorded.
Floor satisfaction and cross-release linkability are re-evaluated.

cases.input: Instrument A is withdrawn while instrument B remains.
cases.expect: Only basis assertions citing A close prospectively.
